Along the way, we’ve made significant improvements to further optimize the game. We hope you enjoy this update and the smoother gameplay experience we’ve worked hard to deliver.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other Changes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]A new [url="https://www.gamersky.com/z/old-market-simulator"]Chinese wiki[/url], thanks to Gamersky![/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support enhancements for better hints and navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Translation updates[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added hotkeys (1-9) for quick inventory navigation.
[*] Added a confirmation dialog when going to bed.
[*] Updated hoe usage on trees to yield the starting seedling. 
[*] Fixed a bug that produced incorrect profit percentages.
[*] Fixed an issue where customers could become stuck during the Easter event.
[*] Reduced the origami spawn rate to once every 28 days.
[*] The calendar now correctly displays the heart symbol on the front.
[*] Enabled skipping the calendar tutorial using the calendar prop.

[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.0 Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

It’s hard to believe, but it’s almost been a year since we launched Old Market Simulator! To celebrate this special milestone, we’ve prepared an exciting update for you. It’s been an incredible journey and we want to take a moment to thank each and every one of you for your amazing support. We couldn’t have made it this far without you and we’re excited about the future of Old Market Simulator, with more major announcements on the way.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Museum[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/8cf1b3448db02ad229fee6807459daeb4a5d3e8d.png[/img]

The museum has opened on both of our islands! It's now time to display the fish you've caught in the lovely aquarium. Oh, and we've also hidden 12 origami around the islands for you to find and display in the museum!

[h2]Alchemy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/20f6961e9fd47a4154b3bef2ded919d5d3d26485.png[/img]

Collect flowers from the map, get a Potion Boiler from the Engineer and combine them with various ingredients to craft 4 mysterious potions to sell to your customers!

[h2]Cheese Making[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/23b925a62a0c5feac9ab6a1347981c049f6d3cd5.png[/img]

The Engineer now has a Cheese Machine for you to start crafting delicious cheese to sell to your customers!

[h2]Spice Machine[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/9c0db84122a1cffb00cb9fb6a0e7c7fe6495806f.png[/img]

It's time to create your own spices! Gather mint leaves, cumin herbs and cultivate chili peppers to prepare spices like mint, cumin and chili powder using the Spice Machine.

[h2]Full Controller Support[/h2]

With the improvements to the UI and enhanced controller support, we now have full controller support, allowing you to play Old Market Simulator without the need for a keyboard and mouse. Who knows what might come out of the box next that will make use of this feature? 👀

[h2]Other Changes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Silk Road event has been updated to reflect price increases on the event products.
[*] 6 new products have been added.
[*] Resources can now be stacked up to 6 items.
[*] New achievements have been added.
[*] The "Unstuck" button has been added to the pause menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing boats to disappear in lakes.
[*] UI improvements to enhance the overall experience.
[*] Performance improvements.
[*] Translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved collision detection over terrain to address sticking issues.
[*] Fixed a bug causing missing parts in the weapon stand on the tropical island.
[*] The Silkroad event now features new products and is correctly displayed on the calendar.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.5 Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

We're excited to introduce our 1.5.5 update! We hope you enjoy the new content and changes. Since the release of our new map, we've been gathering valuable feedback from our community and we’d like to thank everyone for their contributions. [b]Also, we're working on something big and exciting which we can't wait to share more details with you in the upcoming weeks![/b]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/eb1896ac4c5d16d5f57257444220353b4ff3f7f5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Rice and tea are now available in East Town.
[*] New paintings are now available in East Town.
[*] Players can now purchase a modular wall in East Town to create partitions inside their open market. You can also place paintings and lights on it for customization.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/a687cdb153e24f0c62466520c0ab29611e22761c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Resources and machines from East Town have been introduced to Tropical Town, allowing players to craft weapons.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Items placed near the cellar wall will no longer decay unexpectedly. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the fishing trap count was incorrect.
[*] Addressed multiple reports of players getting stuck in certain areas.
[*] Customers in East Town will no longer incorrectly ask for Orange Roughy.
[*] The rays now swim normally, correcting previous movement issues.
[*] Sales prices and event related economy have been tweaked for better balance.
[*] Translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.0 East Town Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

We are excited to announce that our next major update will be [b]available on January 20[/b], while our 40% discount continues. We’ve been working really hard on this update and we can’t wait to hear your feedback. We love our community and we couldn’t have come this far without your support. You can expect more exciting updates soon, as we’ve already started working on them! 🎈

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]New Map: East Town[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/97a84f9c40bea2ef2887d57c63f9a4bca45588f2.png[/img]
Start an exciting new session to experience our new map, set in a cozy Eastern town. East Town features an open market concept to create a fresh and dynamic look and provide more space for you to customize your market.

[h2]Harvesting[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/cc18c33e101dc3fedd4d84b2e816951b9bbf7b56.png[/img]
Get a pickaxe from the Engineer to harvest iron, copper, and zinc, or collect bamboo. Explore the rural areas of the town to find different resources. Harvested resources will respawn after a certain time, so don’t forget to check them later!

[h2]New Workshop Equipment[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/84f27d7f80a2be1d1b003e27358ac71dcfd96577.png[/img]
Craft weapons by melting ores into ingots with the Melting Machine, then placing the required items on the Anvil and striking them with the Hammer, which is also available from the Engineer.

[h2]New Products & Stands[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/0468756a4d583f6113c726639bf1e4a59e9e15e0.png[/img]
Bows, swords, and more! Display and sell your handmade weapons in the new Weapon Stand! Don’t forget to decorate and design your market with the beautiful new lanterns and ceiling platforms.

[h2]New Fishing Areas[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/a6df09fc7f3b4c454285390056c779e0356b5320.png[/img]
Explore new fishing areas such as swamps and lakes to catch new fish like ray, tuna, and goby. Some fish, like lobster, will require you to have a fish trap to catch. Who knows what else might be caught on your rod in the mysterious waters? 👀

[h2]New Events[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/48423177903b3e48ba604876e35a2c65d6ba5501.png[/img]
Experience fresh new events from the Lunar New Year to the Blacksmith Fest on the new map, which will require careful planning to maximize your profits while enjoying the cozy scenery. Don’t forget to check your calendar!

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]

We now have a main menu where you can select a map and easily navigate with a controller.

[h2]Other Changes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Cows now drop bones and leather, which can be used in crafting weapons.
[*] Key rebindings are now properly displayed in the control hints.
[*] New achievements have been added.
[*] Controller support has been improved, offering a smoother experience. Full controller support is coming soon, allowing you to play the game without needing a mouse and keyboard.
[*] The leaderboard has been removed due to increasing concerns about cheating.
[*] UI improvements to enhance the overall look and feel.
[*] Minor performance improvements.
[*] Translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: New Map & Steam Awards Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Before asking for your vote to nominate our beloved game in the Steam Awards, we want to take a moment to express our gratitude. The success of Old Market Simulator is built on the invaluable feedback and unwavering support we’ve received from our amazing community. Your suggestions, reviews, and comments inspire us to keep improving and making the game more enjoyable for every type of player.

[h3]New Map[/h3]

Our next big milestone is a brand new map, and we’re thrilled to announce that we’re working hard to release this exciting update by the end of January 2025. Below, you’ll find a sneak peek screenshot of the new map, we hope you’re as excited as we are!

[h3]Steam Awards[/h3]

If you’ve been enjoying our game and are excited about what’s to come, we’d be grateful if you could take a moment to nominate Old Market Simulator for the Steam Awards. There are several categories to choose from, so pick the one that resonates most with your experience. For example:

[list]
[*] If you enjoy playing with friends, the [b]“Better With Friends Award”[/b] could be a perfect fit.
[*] If you’ve faced the challenge of going bankrupt (but kept trying!), the [b]“Best Game You Suck At Award”[/b] might feel just right. 😄
[/list]
[b]Your support means the world to us! You can cast your vote here: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/20fd7c2ffd9b6835d2cce2e03012a1321e00d916.png[/img]

Thank you so much for your time and support.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Apiary Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

We are excited to release our first major update after the 1.0 launch. Thank you all for your interest and support in the game so far. Our community has been vital since the beginning of early development, and it continues to be! We hope you enjoy the new update. We are also happy to announce that we have already started working on the next major update, which will introduce a brand new map!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Apiary[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/7e1ae9987de096495e68f0f2ca8e636f380fcaa8.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Use a sweep net to collect bees from around fully grown trees, place them in hives, and harvest honey.
[/list]

[h2]Jam Machine[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/c466b80965f1c826bfc484425187943903674ca8.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Prepare homemade jams using your homegrown products as ingredients.
[/list]

[h2]New Products & Trees & Seeds[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/d08064e77388c807474e2680124d1d33607de67d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Grow plum, orange, and cherry trees, and plant sugar seeds.
[/list]

[h2]New Boat[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/a61925e8922a94cb41572a7df4d8d7f0ca6ac88d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Larger and faster boat for smoother travel.
[/list]

[h2]New Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/c0c70ea6e6c3c7aa7033ad78a54107bbd7ec86b7.png[/img]

[list]
[*] A dog, gear carpet, fire bin, black paddle, and advanced fishing rod.
[/list]

[h2]Larger Cellar[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/11257f20368825a507a1bd3192364637c1e991d0.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The cellar now has a second floor to store more items!
[/list]

[h2]New Settings[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/75d3fef347d7da4867114f4d3c862a25e0e52e98.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Product Draw Distance for performance improvement, Key rebinding for keyboard and controller, FOV slider, and toggle sprint option.
[/list]

[h2]New Recipes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/8c4a596bec32063f8dafc2a909d62efeea5ec201.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Meat cutter now has new recipes to cut regular and brown fish.
[/list]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fresh achievements to unlock.
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fully grown trees can now spawn bees with a certain chance at the start of each day.
[*] Rotten items older than a week and not on market stands are automatically destroyed.
[*] Boats now offer stairs for convenient boarding.
[*] Items can now be thrown into the buoy's fire.
[*] Signs are now placeable on terrain.
[*] Some items, like junk, are now displayed locally on the player’s camera.
[*] Throwing a bag while it contains items will now drop items on the ground.
[*] Added an “isModded” flag in the GameManager script for mod creators.
[*] Rain and snow particles no longer penetrate water.
[*] Soil and trees planted on rainy days are automatically watered.
[*] Trees can now be removed with a double-sided hoe.
[*] Beet and eggplant harvest amounts adjusted to yield a full stack.
[*] Beet seeds are now larger.
[*] Inventory item names are now consistently sorted across all languages.
[*] Fixed a bug in the alcohol machine causing negative profit in the daily summary.
[*] Junkman now pays attention to the durability of tools.
[*] The leaderboard now displays only weekly results.
[*] Barn animals are quieter over distance.
[*] New cat sounds.
[*] Visual bug fixes on certain events.
[*] Collision improvements for stands.
[*] Minor UI improvements.
[*] Translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Post-Release Roadmap Announcement
notes.content:
[b]This is our plan for the future updates of Old Market Simulator. Please note that the order of these subjects may change, and some will be introduced with major updates one at a time. We will continue making the game more enjoyable with your support. Thank you for being with us on this journey. ❤️ [/b]


[b]New Maps[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore fresh and exciting maps for new adventures in diverse locations, each with unique settings and challenges.
[/list]

[b]More Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Discover new animals, workshop machines, products, and decorations to enhance your market.
[/list]

[b]Merchant Ships[/b]
[list]
[*] Merchant ships will arrive during events, bringing various products for you to buy and sell in your market.
[/list]

[b]In-Game Chat[/b]
[list]
[*] Communicate with other players directly within the game.
[/list]

[b]In-Game Wiki[/b]
[list]
[*] A built-in wiki with detailed information about game mechanics, items, and features to help you navigate the game.
[/list]

[b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]
[list]
[*] Collect trading cards to showcase your progress and dedication to the game.
[/list]

[b]Improved Controller Support[/b]
[list]
[*] Better controller support for a smoother experience.
[/list]

[b]Steam Cloud Save[/b]
[list]
[*] Save your progress to the Steam cloud, accessible from any device.
[/list]

[b]
Safe Harbor Statement:[/b]
[i]The roadmap for our game is subject to change. Game development is a complex and volatile process, and our strategy may need adjustment as the project evolves. Additionally, the roadmap may change based on suggestions and feedback from our players. Please do not regard this roadmap as a guaranteed plan. We appreciate your understanding and continued support as we work towards enhancing the game experience for all our players.[/i]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Workshop machines can now give multiple outputs, which are indicated by the recipe paper.
[*] The alcohol machine now automatically spawns the outputs when it is complete.
[*] Increased the chance slightly to catch baby shark and swordfish
[*] Added flowers to the flower pot.
[*] The big Victorian carpet is actually big now.
[*] The horse tutorial now covers the cost for the purchase.
[*] Readjusted product costs yielded from trees and animals to reflect profit accurately. The initial investment for the animal/tree is still taken into account, and each harvest will increase your profit as it covers the initial investment.
[*] Readjusted fish costs from fish traps and fishing rods based on the durability of those items to reflect profit accurately.
[*] Readjusted product costs yielded from workshop machines based on the cost of ingredients to reflect profit accurately.
[*] Junkman no longer gives the empty crate bonus for products without crates, such as meat and fish.
[*] Fixed a problem affecting extra reputation gained from decorations.
[*] Modified the terrain near the cellar and other areas to prevent players from getting stuck.
[*] Modified the path of the horses near the greenhouse entrance to prevent players from getting stuck by the horses.
[*] Fences will now properly collide with NPCs and horses.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing customers from disabling their collision while heading to the checkout.
[*] Collision improvements on event props.
[*] Updated hoe icon.
[*] Translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 Full Release Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

The moment has arrived! We’re thrilled to announce that our game is officially transitioning from Early Access to its [b]full release on October 3 at 10 AM PT.[/b] This update is the result of our hard work and the invaluable feedback we’ve received from our community. To celebrate, we’re offering 40% off in a Daily Deal on the Steam Home Page! A huge thank you to all of you for making this possible. We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements! As always, we’re eager to hear your feedback on our Discord channel.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Livestock[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/7ecdb240f94d828450fe1d3ec7abad28ef976f86.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Get cows, goats, and chickens from the animal store to start raising your animals in your barn.
[*] Grab the food basket and feed them day by day, and they’ll provide you with their yield, such as milk and eggs.
[*] If you prefer to be the butcher, we have introduced a variety of meats.
[/list]

[h2]Workshop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/0153a925b1d9c6fcc5a93f27e3c64e07ed68a5ca.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The Engineer has arrived in town, where you can acquire different tools to produce even more of your goods!
[*] Cut your meats on the meat cutter, bake something fresh in the oven, or ferment beer in the alcohol machine.
[*] Recipes are available for each tool to help you get started.
[/list]

[h2]Trees[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/ad05070ca4a19606b02ae07c1cdf84c803b64f5d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We have added a variety of trees that you can plant on your terrain and harvest their yield.
[/list]

[h2]Fish Trap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/8c23781de62b4f0e8b0e172a07740091c894d0d8.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can now get the new fish trap from the Lumberjack and place it in the water to catch fish daily.
[/list]

[h2]New Horse Inventory[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/7521739695345295c40112f32e79f218c2ef973b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The horses now have a new inventory system that will hold your items more conveniently.
[/list]

[h2]New Products[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/0266fdd515a2385d232a6b770e2d4763b464ee1e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Meats, spices, fruits and more! We’ve added over 20 new products for you to sell to your customers.
[/list]

[h2]New Decorations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/adfda1634d0153dc292d0a8bdae87736b0de3ada.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Cats, new paintings, buoys, and many more! Decorations can now increase your max reputation value—discover them in the Grand Bazaar!
[/list]

[h2]Max Players Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/bff379cb9959b403ec6e37d2b44883f32dc2ca56.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now that there is a lot more to do, the maximum player count has been increased to 4 so you can bring more friends!
[/list]

[h2]Inventory Panel[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/6cc4a5e6f75139cf0ee442c6abba535fa83516cb.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can now view your stock anytime by pressing TAB.
[/list]

[h2]New Expansions[/h2]

[list]
[*] Expand your barn to raise more animals!
[/list]

[h2]New Graphics Settings[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added options for VSYNC, FPS Limiter, and shadow quality.
[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

[list]
[*] We have introduced 10 new achievements on Steam.

notes.title: 0.2.0 Fishing Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're excited to introduce our latest major update, which is our biggest one since release. We hope you enjoy the new features and changes. With your support, we're making the game more enjoyable day by day. Thank you all for helping us on this journey. We're also happy to announce that we are now focused on the 1.0 (full release) update!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Fishing & Sailing[/h2]

[list]
[*] It's time to catch fish and sell them at your market with two special new fish stands!
[*] Get a boat, a paddle, and a fishing rod from the lumberjack to start fishing.
[*] There are two regular fish and seven special ones that can be found in designated fishing zones!
[*] The sea might also surprise you with some sunken items, which may or may not be profitable as well.
[/list]

[h2]Clothing Store[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new store has opened in town where you can purchase different sizes of bags to increase your inventory slots!
[/list]

[h2]Max Players Update[/h2]

[list]
[*] The maximum player count has been increased to 3, so you can bring more friends! To avoid confusion, each player will have a unique character with their nickname displayed above them.
[/list]

[h2]Pause[/h2]

[list]
[*] You can now pause the game if you are the only player in the world.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Daytime has been increased from 10 minutes to 14 minutes.
[*] You can now see item names in the bottom right corner.
[*] Expansion capacities and customer spawn rates have been increased to improve market flow.
[*] Maintenance, rent, and employee costs have been reduced.
[*] Horses are now forbidden from entering the market and cellar. They also can't approach the cellar door to prevent players from getting stuck inside. Additionally, they are less noisy.
[*] Customers headed to the checkout counter no longer get stuck on other customers, resolving issues with checkout congestion.
[*] Customer price tolerance has been increased.
[*] Customers now produce less dirt.
[*] The tutorial HUD has been redesigned to be more prominent.
[*] Completing tutorials now rewards coins to help beginners.
[*] The Junkman no longer gets wet on rainy days.
[*] The Junkman now checks the amount of seeds in the bag.
[*] Improved collisions around the market and Grand Bazaar.
[*] Translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.18 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved translations
[*] Minor UI tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.17 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]

[*] Improved Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean translations.

notes.title: 0.1.16 Junkman Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Junkman has arrived![/h2]
You can now sell your items for half their price using the Junkman's grinder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/c3ae02cd81bab438a66c49f121a46b74ae8f0b76.png[/img]

[h2]Signs![/h2]
You can place signs on floors and walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/e7c801f045feec92e7ccc7035c2e270500973aeb.png[/img]
It is now possible to rename your Market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923812/b0505366289d5a33bd77be40503754196fc32230.png[/img]

[h2]New Stands[/h2]
[list]
[*] Place your goods vertically with the new vertical stands.
[*] There is also a new flat stand, perfect for your big crates or nuts.
[/list]
[h2]New Decoration[/h2]
The Easter bunny is available at the Decoration store during the Easter event to add warmth to your market.

[h2]Calendar[/h2]
A calendar can now be hung on your market's wall to track events.

[h2]Carpet Update[/h2]
Customers taking items from on top of a carpet reduces the probability of dirtiness by 50%.

[h2]New Bankruptcy System[/h2]
[list]
[*] You will now receive an alert dialog when you end the day with a negative balance instead of just a notification.
[*] Getting bankrupt no longer ends your game or deletes your save file. Instead, you are unable to open your market until your balance is positive. The Junkman can help with this if you have enough items to sell.
[/list]
[h2]Event Tooltip[/h2]
You can now view event details by hovering over the event title at the top.

[h2]Invert Y Axis[/h2]
An option to invert the Y-axis has been added.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] It can now rain in winter.
[*] Rainy weather now waters the dirt.
[*] Lighting optimizations have been implemented.
[*] The broom is now more durable and cheaper.
[*] Employee prices have been reduced.
[*] Greenhouse prices have been reduced.
[*] Cellar prices have been reduced.
[*] Horse prices have been reduced.
[*] The lumberjack area has been expanded.
[*] Translations are improved.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the joining client to be unable to remove seeds with the hoe.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.14 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Animal Market and Barn.
[*] You can now buy horses to help carry goods.
[*] New light: Torch
[*] Implemented statistical data collection on the cloud for future features such as global leaderboards.
[*] Fixed the issue of falling from the cable car during wartime events.
[*] Event props like corpses and balloons on water are now floating.
[*] Updated customer spawning logic to increase variety.
[*] You can now place flowers in front of windows.
[*] Customers will now always complain if there are more than 7 dirt spots, regardless of market capacity.
[*] The Wiki button now directs to the correct wiki page.
[*] Fixed an issue where items on the stand were being pushed by other physics objects.
[*] Added game save notification.
[*] Removed default farm lights; you can now place your own lights on the dirt as well.
[*] Improved translations.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The capacity contribution of expansions is doubled, resulting in a total of 50 capacity when you buy all of the market expansions.
[*] Customer spawn interval is increased by 30%, resulting in a more crowded circulation.
[*] Visual and collision improvements for the terrain.
[*] Translation corrections.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that broke the physics system, resulting in unexpected behaviors with moving objects.
[*] Fixed an issue causing employees not to show up due to the incorrect execution order of the save system, which caused incorrect remaining funds when loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the back of the cellar not to work, resulting in item decay.
[*] You will be notified in the morning if you don’t have enough money for the employees.
[*] Restockers no longer waste crates if their target is filled by the player or another restocker. They will simply drop their crates in front of the target product.
[*] Collision improvements.
[*] Several improvements to the map to prevent falling/stuck issues.
[*] Russian translation improvements.
[*] Gooseberries can now be placed on the cellar stand.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added support for Russian and Ukrainian languages.
[*] Enabled the Christmas tree to be used as a light source.
[*] Fixed a bug causing items left on the cable car to disappear.
[*] Made adjustments to UI font sizes.
[*] Improved the durability of the broom and hoe.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where host was getting disconnected when a client tries to join but fails.

[/list]

[/list]
